assets.description: Full Academy hero background: azul-academy gradient (#345D90 left to #172A45 right, horizontal) plus a low-opacity layered vertical-bar/line-art texture.
assets.use: Inline this SVG as the background for hero sections, title slides, and banners. If the deliverable format can't embed a complex SVG, fall back to the flat gradient (linear-gradient(90deg, #345D90 0%, #172A45 100%)) instead of fabricating a different texture.
